root_cause: The error rate high alert and HTTP 503 errors in order-gateway are caused by database connection rejections originating from recent configuration change CHG-4471 in reference-db which lowered max_connections from 500 to 60, causing new connections above this limit to be rejected. This is supported by error logs in order-gateway and reference-db warning about connection rejections tied to this change.
